question.text: Under PIT, the structured digital database of UPSI recipients must be preserved for a period NOT LESS THAN:

answer.text: 8 years after completion of transactions (or till end of SEBI proceedings)

explanation.text: The Logic: Per SEBI (PIT) (Amendment) Regulations 2020, the structured digital database shall be preserved for at least 8 years after completion of the relevant transactions or till completion of SEBI proceedings. The Trap: 3/5/10 years are incorrect. Cross-Exam Context: Longer preservation than standard 5-year AIF books requirement. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Do NOT outsource the digital database — hosting must be internal with audit trail.
